defaults.heading: Stay in the loop
defaults.text: Get new stories and updates in your inbox.

css: .tb-news-footer{background:var(--tb-color-secondary);color:var(--tb-color-background)}.tb-news-footer__inner{max-width:var(--tb-news-footer-width);margin:auto;padding:58px 24px 28px}.tb-news-footer__top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.9fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);gap:52px}.tb-news-footer__newsletter{padding:26px;border-radius:18px}.tb-news-footer__heading{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:28px}.tb-news-footer__text{margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.6;opacity:.75}.tb-news-footer__form{display:flex;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 25%,transparent);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.tb-news-footer__input{padding:11px 13px;flex:1;opacity:.55}.tb-news-footer__button{padding:0 16px;border:0;background:var(--tb-color-primary);color:#fff;font-weight:800}.tb-news-footer__menus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--tb-news-footer-columns),minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px}.tb-news-footer__group-title{display:block;margin-bottom:11px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:850}.tb-news-footer__children{display:grid;gap:8px}.tb-news-footer__single{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;opacity:.72}.tb-news-footer__single:hover{opacity:1}.tb-news-footer__copyright{margin:38px 0 0;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 20%,transparent);font-size:13px;opacity:.65}.tb-menu-empty{color:inherit;opacity:.65}@media(max-width:760px){.tb-news-footer__top{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tb-news-footer__menus{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:480px){.tb-news-footer__menus{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
name: Newsletter and Menu Footer
description: A strong newsletter callout paired with saved menu groups.
